text:
ravi_sales: Mark from Orion wants a 4-week air-gapped POC in their colo. Must-run requirements: customer HSM signing (no vendor keys), weekly minibundles, monthly fulls, ability to deliver emergency USB hotfixes. Bandwidth estimate ~45GB/week. Any immediate blockers?

sam_se: We can support this. Recommend unsigned minibundles + a signing-helper container that runs in their jumpbox and uses PKCS#11. Need HSM vendor and middleware path.

nora_infra: Packaging notes: to keep weekly diffs small we must avoid shipping model weights unless necessary. Pinning drivers or custom kernels will bloat diffs. Suggest policy: weekly deltas cannot include DB/schema migrations; migrations go in monthly full. Also need their checksum preference (sha256 default).

tess_sec: Security redlines from questionnaire: 1) Redwood must never receive or store private keys; 2) signing attestations and audit logs must remain customer-local; 3) any fallback with pre-signed artifacts requires documented custody transfer. We'll add SOW language.

mark_cust: Orion uses Luna and will run tooling in an isolated jumpbox. For emergencies we want a sealed USB workflow where we sign locally and physically transfer to ops. Also want an SLA: minibundle health check and auto-revert within 30 minutes.

sam_se: Example sign flow (run inside their network):
```
# run in jumpbox with PKCS#11
docker run --rm -v /mnt/artifacts:/artifacts redwood/sign-helper:stable \
  sign --bundle /artifacts/minibundle.tar.gz \
  --pkcs11-module /usr/lib/libpkcs11.so --slot 0 --pin-file /run/hsm/pin \
  --out /artifacts/minibundle.sig

# verify locally with our verify binary
redwood-verify --manifest /artifacts/manifest.json --sig /artifacts/minibundle.sig
```

nora_infra: Rollback plan: staged canary deploy (5/25/100) with health probes and auto-revert. For DB migrations we require a manual migration in monthly full with reversible SQL. We'll include a preflight checklist: disk >= 500GB, container runtime allowed, HSM middleware present, dry-run namespace.

tess_sec: SOW draft line: "Redwood will provide signing tooling only. Customer retains exclusive custody of private keys. Redwood will not accept or persist private key material. Any pre-signed artifact accepted by Redwood must be accompanied by a customer-signed custody attestation."

pkg-bot: created PKG-5012: sign-helper container + Luna PKCS#11 example + USB hotfix runbook + preflight checklist.

ravi_sales: Pricing: propose one-time packaging & validation $14k + per-minibundle handling $550. Mark, can you confirm procurement tolerance? I'll schedule a sync Wed 9am PT to walk them through the runbook and pricing.

mark_cust: Procurement okay with the numbers in principle. One ask: can Redwood provide a short verification checklist we can run after signing so our ops can validate before install?

sam_se: Yes, we'll add a two-step verify: signature verification + manifest/sha256 checksum check; include example commands in the README.

ravi_sales: Great. Actions: @sam_se prototype signing-helper + README with verify examples, @nora_infra finalize preflight one-pager and rollback runbook, @tess_sec finalize SOW clause. Meeting Wed 9am PT. :thumbsup:
